Short/Long-Term Rental This fully furnished residence has been tastefully rebuilt and is situated on an extra-large lot set far back from the street for exceptional privacy. The home features a custom bath and shower, a walk-in closet, recessed LED lighting, modern finishes, and appliances with an eat-in kitchen island. Highlights include a new high-efficiency heating and cooling system, in-unit washer/dryer, and a well-designed layout offering both comfort and functionality. Enjoy living close to the Presidio and nearby parks in the heart of the desirable Laurel Heights. Lease Furnished All Utilities Included (Water, PG&E, Garbage, Internet) Gourmet Kitchen with Island Dining Bertazzoni Gas Range Dishwasher & Garbage Disposal Under-Counter Accent Lighting European Summit Ingenious Refrigerator Heating & A/C System with Remote Control Stainless Steel Appliances Living Room & Dining Area Walk-In Closet Custom Cabinetry Washer/Dryer Tankless Water Heater

Looking for a short/Long-term one person tenant.
